tagline.en: Everything the Nepal civil service exam needs, in one house — laws, syllabus, subjects, practice and a rank-first plan.
tagline.ne: नेपालको लोकसेवा परीक्षालाई चाहिने सबै कुरा एउटै घरमा — कानून, पाठ्यक्रम, विषय, अभ्यास र रैंक ल्याउने योजना।

disclaimer.en: Syllabus structure, marks and negative marking are compiled from public information about the Commission's Section Officer selection. Always confirm the current year's syllabus and notice on psc.gov.np before you plan. Every question in the practice bank here was written by ACTTOLOG for study — it is not an official question paper.
disclaimer.ne: पाठ्यक्रमको संरचना, अङ्क र नकारात्मक अङ्क कर्मचारी चयन आयोगको शाखा अधिकृत चयनसम्बन्धी सार्वजनिक सूचनाबाट संकलन गरिएको हो। योजना बनाउनुअघि आयोगको आधिकारिक साइट psc.gov.np मा हालको वर्षको विषयसूची र सूचना अनिवार्य पुष्टि गर्नुहोस्। यहाँको अभ्यास प्रश्नहरू ACTTOLOG ले पढाइका लागि लेखेको हो, आयोगको आधिकारिक प्रश्नपत्र होइन।

use.en: Full text of acts and rules, free download
use.ne: ऐन र नियमावलीको पूर्ण पाठ, निःशुल्क डाउनलोड

name.en: Ministry of Home Affairs — Acts / Regulations

note.en: This is the gate. Most candidates lose the race here, not in the written stage.
note.ne: यो ढोका हो। धेरैजसो प्रतिस्पर्धी यहीँ हार्छन्, लिखित चरणमा होइन।

note.en: Social, economic, development and environmental issues of Nepal.
note.ne: नेपालको सामाजिक, आर्थिक, विकासगतरूप र वातावरणीय मुद्दा।
व्यवस्थापन, राजस्व, लेखा, लेखा परीक्षण, संघीयता।

note.en: Computer literacy — word, sheet, internet, official use.
note.ne: कम्प्युटर साक्षरता — वर्ड, शीट, इन्टरनेट, कार्यालय प्रयोग।

note.en: How you argue, listen and lead a group.
note.ne: तपाईंले समूहमा कसरी तर्क, सुनाइ र नेतृत्व गर्नुहुन्छ।

note.en: Depth of service subject, clarity, composure.
note.ne: सेवा विषयको गहिराइ, स्पष्टता र शान्ति।

intro.en: The first paper tests speed with accuracy across five families: geography, history and polity with economy, science and technology, mental ability, and language. One mark for a right answer, and a fifth of it gone for a wrong one — so guessing is a skill you must train, not a habit you must keep.
intro.ne: पहिलो पेपरले पाँच परिवारमा गति र शुद्धता नाप्छ: भूगोल, इतिहास-राजनीति र अर्थतन्त्र, विज्ञान-प्रविधि, मानसिक क्षमता, र भाषा। सही उत्तरमा एक अङ्क, गलतमा त्यसको पाँचौं भाग घट्छ — त्यसैले अनुमान तालिम लिनुपर्ने सीप हो, बानी होइन।

strategy.en: Answer in three passes: certain first, probable second, blank last. With 20% negative marking, leaving a question empty is often the better bet than a coin flip.
strategy.ne: तीन चरणमा उत्तर दिनुहोस्: पक्का पहिले, सम्भावित दोस्रो, खाली अन्त्यमा। २०% नकारात्मक अङ्कमा, प्रश्न खाली छोड्नु धाक्का भन्दा धेरैजसो राम्रो हुन्छ।

title.en: Geography of Nepal and the world

points: Himal, Pahad, Terai and the internal rivers
River systems: Koshi, Gandaki, Karnali, Mahanadi
Climate zones and their effect on settlement
Water, forest, mineral and hydropower potential
Nepal's position in South Asia and its neighbours
Distribution of power: federation, province, local
Three sectors and their share of work
Remittance, trade balance and foreign currency
Energy: hydro, solar, and the grid
E-governance services and their legal base
Data protection and the privacy law
What a new technology changes for a citizen
Speed: what to calculate and what to estimate
Grammar in use: tense, agreement, preposition
Reading a law in one language, writing in the other

intro.en: The written governance paper asks how the state actually runs: the constitution as the source of power, the machinery of public service, and how the country's resources are governed. Answers that quote the right section and name the right body score; answers that stay general do not.
intro.ne: सुशासनको लिखित पेपरले राज्य वास्तवमा कसरी चल्छ भन्ध सोध्छ: सत्ताको स्रोत संविधान, जनसेवाको यन्त्र, र देशको स्रोत कसरी सुशासित हुन्छ भन्ने। सही दफा उद्धृत र सही निकायको नाम लेखेको उत्तरले अङ्क पाउँछ; सामान्य उत्तरले पाउँदैन।

strategy.en: For every unit keep three lines ready: the law that creates it, the body that runs it, and one real example of it working or failing.
strategy.ne: हरेक एकाइका लागि तीन लाइन तयार राख्नुहोस्: त्यसलाई सिर्जना गर्ने कानून, चलाउने निकाय, र चलिरहेको वा असफल भएको एक वास्तविक उदाहरण।

points: Composition and power at three levels
Case law an officer should know
Local Government Operation Act in outline
Planning and budget at the local level
Class, category and the schedule of posts
Audit, human rights and information commissions
RTI Act 2064: what to give, what to refuse
Code of conduct for civil servants
Water, forest, land and mineral law
Climate finance an officer must read
Revenue: Income Tax Act 2058 in outline
Fiscal federalism and the transfer formula

intro.en: This paper rewards a candidate who can describe a Nepali problem precisely, then say what the state can realistically do about it. Four families carry almost every question: society, economy, development, and environment.
intro.ne: यो पेपरले नेपालको समस्या स्पष्टसँग वर्णन गरी, राज्यले वास्तविक रूपमा के गर्न सक्छ भन्न सक्नेलाई पुरस्कार दिन्छ। चार परिवारले लगभग हरेक प्रश्न बोक्छन्: समाज, अर्थतन्त्र, विकास, र वातावरण।

strategy.en: Build a one-page card per issue: what it is, two numbers that prove it, who owns it, what has been tried, what you would do in the first ninety days.
strategy.ne: हरेक मुद्दाको एक पृष्ठको कार्ड बनाउनुहोस्: के हो, प्रमाणित दुई अङ्क, कसको जिम्मा, के गरियो, र पहिलो नब्बे दिनमा तपाईंले के गर्थ्यौं।

points: Brain drain and what reverses it
Why industry stalled and what restarts it
Periodic plans and the current one
Waste and water in growing towns

intro.en: For the general Section Officer post the service subject is the trade of the job: management, revenue, accounting, auditing and how federalism divides the work. This is where a candidate becomes an officer on paper.
intro.ne: सामान्य शाखा अधिकृत पदका लागि सेवा विषय भनेको कामको सीप हो: व्यवस्थापन, राजस्व, लेखा, लेखा परीक्षण र संघीयताले काम कसरी बाँड्छ। यहीँ उम्मेदवार कागजमा अधिकारी बन्छ।

strategy.en: Learn each topic as a workflow, not a definition: who applies, what document moves, what the law requires, what the deadline is, what goes wrong.
strategy.ne: हरेक विषय परिभाषा होइन कार्यप्रवाहको रूपमा सिक्नुहोस्: कसले लगाउँछ, कुन कागज चल्छ, कानूनले के माग्छ, म्याद के हो, के बिग्रन्छ।

points: Each function in an office setting
Motivation and its theories in use
Internal audit in a line agency
Schedules of exclusive and concurrent power
Office of the President and CM roles

why.en: Source of every power you will exercise
why.ne: तपाईंले प्रयोग गर्ने हरेक सत्ताको स्रोत

why.en: How the Commission itself is built
Your career, from entry to retirement
The working detail of the Act
Class, level and the post structure
How files, orders and appeals move
why.ne: फाइल, आदेश र अपील कसरी चल्छ

why.en: What you must give and what you may refuse
why.ne: के दिनुपर्छ, के इनकार गर्न मिल्छ

why.en: The line an officer may never cross
Revenue work and your own return
why.ne: राजस्व काम र आफ्नै कर विवरण

why.en: Where most officers first meet the public

title.en: Read the notice, not the rumour

body.en: Open the Commission's own syllabus PDF and mark every line you cannot yet explain. That list is your real syllabus.
body.ne: आयोगकै विषयसूची खोलेर जुन हरेक लाइन तपाईंले अझै बुझाउन सक्नुहुन्न, चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्। त्यो सूची नै तपाईंको साँचो पाठ्यक्रम हो।

title.en: One subject a day, one paper a week
title.ne: एक दिन एक विषय, एक हप्ता एक पेपर

body.en: Alternate aptitude practice with written-subject reading so speed never dies while depth grows.
body.ne: गहिराई बढ्दा गति नमर्न, योग्यता अभ्यास र लिखित विषयको पठन फेरफेर गर्नुहोस्।

title.en: Write the answer, do not read it

body.en: A written paper is scored on paper. Ten timed answers a week, each with a law, a body and an example.
body.ne: लिखित पेपर कागजमा नापिन्छ। हप्तामा दस समयमा लेखिएका उत्तर — प्रत्येकमा एक कानून, एक निकाय, एक उदाहरण।

title.en: Track the gap, not the hours

body.en: After every test, the questions you got wrong are the only study list that matters. Fill them before adding new material.
body.ne: हरेक परीक्षणपछि गलत उत्तर दिएका प्रश्न नै एकमात्र महत्त्वको सूची हो। नयाँ सामग्री थप्नुअघि तिनै पूरा गर्नुहोस्।

title.en: Prepare the interview from month one

body.en: Sixty marks sit at the end. Your service subject, said out loud in two minutes, is built by repetition, not by last-week cramming.
body.ne: अन्त्यमा साठी अङ्क छ। तपाईंको सेवा विषय दुई मिनेटमा मुखेर् भन्ने अभ्यास दोहोरावृत्तिबाट बन्छ, अन्तिम हप्ताको घुसाइबाट होइन।

q.en: In a series 5, 11, 23, 47, ▢ — which number continues it?

explain.en: Each term is double the previous plus one: 47 × 2 + 1 = 95.
explain.ne: हरेक पद अघिल्लोको दोब्बरमा एक जोड: ४७ × २ + १ = ९५।

q.en: Which river system is the largest of Nepal by basin?
q.ne: नेपालको सिन्धु जलाधार क्षेत्रमा सबैभन्दा ठूलो कुन?

explain.en: The Koshi system drains the largest area of the country's rivers.
explain.ne: कोशी प्रणालीले देशका नदीहरूमध्ये सबैभन्दा बढी क्षेत्र पानी निकास गर्छ।

q.en: Nepali: which word is spelled correctly?
The Constitution of Nepal was promulgated in which Bikram Sambat year?
q.ne: नेपालको संविधान कुन वि.सं. मा जारी भयो?

q.en: A shop marks an item 20% above cost and then gives a 10% discount. What is the profit percent on cost?
q.ne: एक पसलेले वस्तु लागतभन्दा २०% बढीमा राखेर १०% छुट दिन्छ। लागतमा नाफा कति प्रतिशत?

q.en: Choose the correct preposition: The report was submitted ___ the deadline.
q.ne: सही पूर्ियोजन छान्नुहोस्: The report was submitted ___ the deadline.

explain.en: "By the deadline" means not later than it.
explain.ne: by the deadline को अर्थ त्यसभन्दा पछि होइन।

q.en: Which body recommends the number of members and their terms for a provincial assembly?
q.ne: कुन निकायले प्रदेश सभाका सदस्य संख्या र कार्यकाल सिफारिस गर्छ?

explain.en: The Commission is the constitutional body for its own composition and service rules.
explain.ne: आयोग आफ्नो गठन र सेवासम्बन्धी कानूनी निकाय हो।

q.en: Under the RTI Act, if information is refused, what may the applicant do?
q.ne: सूचना अधिकार ऐनअन्तर्गत सूचना इनकार भएमा निवेदकले के गर्न सक्छ?

options.en: Review then appeal to the Commission
Sue immediately in the district court

explain.en: First a review by the designated officer, then appeal to the Information Commission.
explain.ne: पहिले तोकिमै अधिकारीबाट पुनरावलोकन, त्यसपछि सूचना आयोगमा जोहर।

q.en: Which is the largest share of Nepal's household income from abroad?
q.ne: विदेशबाट आउने घरेलु आम्दानोको सबैभन्दा ठूलो स्रोत कुन?

explain.ne: बाह्य घरेलु आम्दानीमा विप्रेषणको हिस्सा सबैभन्दा ठूलो छ।

q.en: Graduating from LDC status mainly changes which of these?
q.ne: अल्पविकसित देश श्रेणीबाट निस्कँदा मुख्यतः के फेरिन्छ?

options.en: Preferential market access and some aid terms
options.ne: प्राथमिकताप्राप्त बजार पहुँच र केही सहायता सर्त

explain.en: Graduation re-prices trade preferences and part of concessional finance.
explain.ne: स्तरोन्नतिले व्यापार प्राथमिकता र छुटसुविधागत वित्तको सर्त फेर्छ।

q.en: In the budget cycle, which document authorises spending before the year begins?
q.ne: बजेट चक्रमा, वर्ष सुरु हुनुअघि खर्चको अधिकार दिने कागज कुन?

explain.en: Money may be drawn only under an appropriation.
explain.ne: व्यय विधेयकबिना राजकोषबाट पैसा निस्कन मिल्दैन।

q.en: Which audit type asks whether a programme achieved its stated result?
q.ne: कुन लेखा परीक्षणले कार्यक्रमले लक्षित नतिजा पायो कि भन्धर सोध्छ?

explain.en: Performance audit looks at economy, efficiency and effectiveness.
explain.ne: कार्यसम्पादन परीक्षणले मितव्ययिता, दक्षता र प्रभावकारिता हेर्छ।

q.en: Under fiscal federalism, which grant is meant to close the revenue shortfall of a local level?
q.ne: वित्तीय संघीयतामा, स्थानीय तहको राजस्व घाटा घटाउन कुन अनुदान हो?

explain.en: The fiscal commission recommends equalisation grants for shortfall.
explain.ne: वित्त आयोगले घाटा पूरै गर्न बराबरी अनुदान सिफारिस गर्छ।

q.en: What is the first document in a personnel file after selection?
q.ne: चयनपछि व्यक्तिको फाइलमा पहिलो कागज कुन?

explain.en: Selection leads to appointment; the rest follow in service.
explain.ne: चयनपछि नियुक्ति, अनि सेवामा बाँकी आउँछ।
